MAME RUNTIME

Core & ROM storage

Core: checking · ROMs: user-supplied · storage: IndexedDB

Browser core: not loaded

GitHub Pages does not ship proprietary ROMs or a large native MAME binary. MAME WebAssembly requires the compiled JavaScript/WASM runtime plus user-supplied ROM data; native MAME remains available through the local bridge.

AUTOMATIC OCR + VISION

Scan, segment, label, transliterate and research inscriptions.

UTF-8 Ancient North Arabian glyphs, reading-order analysis, provenance-aware web research, manual correction and local model inference. Automatic OCR is enabled through the shared local/browser pipeline; Tesseract is used where a compatible model exists.
